description.p: You gain resistance to poison damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, your inner power awakens, granting you the ability to cast the poison spray cantrip. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

sheet.description: You gain resistance to poison damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, you learn the poison spray cantrip instead. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.
